openAtLogin.label: Open Colorpicker at login
openAtLogin.description: Launch Colorpicker automatically when you log in

keepOnTop.label: Keep Colorpicker on top
keepOnTop.description: Always display Colorpicker above other windows

closeToTray.label: Close to tray
closeToTray.description: Keep Colorpicker running in the system tray instead of quitting when the window is closed

resetSettings.label: Reset settings to default
resetSettings.description: Restore all settings to their original default values

gridSize.label: Pixel Grid Size
gridSize.description: Set the size of the pixel grid displayed in the magnifier

magnifierSize.label: Magnifier Size
magnifierSize.description: Set the diameter of the circular magnifier window

showHex.label: Show Hex Code
showHex.description: Display the hex color code in the magnifier

hideMain.label: Hide Main Window
hideMain.description: Automatically hide the main Colorpicker window when using the magnifier

detectBackgroundChanges.label: Detect Background Changes
detectBackgroundChanges.description: Poll for color changes while the cursor is stationary, useful for picking colors from video or animations

allowHoverThrough.label: Allow Hover Through
allowHoverThrough.description: Let mouse events pass through the magnifier so you can pick hover-state colors from underlying windows

pickerHotkey.label: Launch Picker Hotkey
pickerHotkey.description: Global keyboard shortcut to launch the color picker from anywhere, even when Colorpicker is closed

hotkey.noModifier: Include at least one modifier key
hotkey.reserved: This shortcut is reserved by the system
